title: V03: verify configured prefixes with an immutable environment literal
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Implement and preserve a bounded configured-prefix source verifier. It accepts the exact authenticated original prefix rendering with only eight top-level gate literal values replaced by independently pinned plain data. Nongate bytes must match exactly. The pure checks cover UTF8 byte offsets, exact types, duplicate gates, inert expressions and bounds; accepted gate DATA is not an admission.

A separately reviewed constructor successor changes only the native environment literal from a bytes-key dictionary to six immutable bytes pairs. Every constructor function body remains byte-identical and `dict(NATIVE_ENV)` returns the same six-entry mapping. The tuple is compatible with the original closure literal parser without a mutable exemption. Future policy must select constructor v2; the old v1 remains an inert comparison.

The exact frozen core hashes are `1ed813148c10d5fbd3cd6781d51eca650a347eda7a6323f581d740e6ea9cb6e2` (verifier) and `a80a60b390bc60e9bc434b79cda5ae6db88e4f0c6c7436de9adfe1f48a2045b1` (constructor v2). The package has 29 files, 173,055 raw bytes and 18 copied-origin records. This is a completed narrow pure-source increment; full C05 and full V03 remain open.

## Task and overlap

Canonical base `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`. This follows #6362's pure prefix/fixture/observer work at `120072d58ddb46f0e02886756243174d41fce42e`, #6363's actual parent/interface audit at `a8cf650b7435ccea237084e491e339f725c0a35b`, and #6367's finite-cover source constraints at `234a650277d286f2ebec104eb65ce9456f80667c`. It closes the specific configured-source-derivation and bytes-key literal capture edges. A separate conditional supervision contribution retains real-owner/bootstrap/interval dependencies.

TASK.json records the explicitly changed publication subtask relative to the historical portable-replay card, with the original scientific objective and denominators preserved. The named overlap is bounded; no novelty or global exhaustive-search claim. This result adds no original activity credit: original 43.5%, 22/49 activities, stage 2/10, milestones 1/10, 24 components and 52 helpers are unchanged.

## Validation

Standard-library Python 3.12, repository root:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/h25-v03-configured-prefix-derivation --check-only
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/h25-v03-configured-prefix-derivation
```

Local metadata/pins, registered preservation checks and eight new pure fixture methods passed in normal and optimized modes. A final-manifest-bound package-only cold copy passed both profiles; outputs are outside the packet and all final package bytes remained identical. The adapter only rebinds fixture IMPL/ORIGINAL paths. Core, fixture, assertions and algorithms are unchanged. Committed-byte/mode/declared-history preflight passed for all 29 files; the exact added-only remote tree and parent match local. Actual hosted results will be reported after completion at the published head.

Original variant and closure source, older constructor and pre-repair verifier are inert `.py.txt` evidence. No original function/module, receiver capture, Root, Popen, native control, compiler, namespace or target workload runs. Static source compatibility is not actual receiver-policy/module-identity/48-module closure fit. All None gates, pre-repair evidence and source-window timing gaps remain visible. No private Pro transcript is exported; documentary hash references are external context, not live replay inputs. Git provenance covers declared base/card inputs, not complete original source history.

The app goal is separately paused. Current guarded attempt approval remains false; old recorded policy debit 94.550533479/2400 seconds is not complete physical cost. Preparation, review, publication and other physical costs remain OPEN_NOT_ZERO.
